validation_split: Stratified 80/20, random_state=42; fixed across all rounds
scope: Local validation only; official test labels are unavailable.
path_sanitization: Absolute project and user-home paths replaced by placeholders.
notes: Initial double-splitting produced 143 validation rows and was rejected; the model corrected it.
One inspection cell returned no predictions; 58 of 60 code executions produced valid scores.
LLM-assembled scripts are retained for audit and were not validated as faithful reproductions.
winning_cell.py is exact executed first-round cell 20 and was replayed successfully in a fresh process.
The original logger stripped non-ASCII characters; archived logs preserve the recorded text.
Later worker logs include inherited parent history; executed_cells.json contains only that worker's own cells.
